scope: Approval of the hash-bound textual candidate and source binding only. Not figure, source glyph, display, count, Gate2, publication or whole-lesson approval.

mathematical_work.mode: Reuse the retained independent recurrence/E70 inquiry and solution without re-solving.

inputs.role: Raw lesson text, image reference not opened
Current registered source erratum and faithful literal domain
Recurrence, algebraic proof and table identity
Read paragraph/boundary functions; no rendering functions invoked
Authoritative text_of soft-line joining and wrap-marker removal

method.raw_snapshots: Candidate source.data was deep-compared with current raw lesson/exercises JSON; actual raw file SHA-256 was compared with candidate source.sha256.
method.authoritative_references: Every prose source_refs and E70 pages reference was resolved to current canonical page.blocks using the one-based source block index; kinds, labels, printed pages and figure identity were checked.
method.source_text: Exact comparison against raw assembled text and canonical reference concatenation using the repository text_of joining rules, including removal of the U+21B5 source-wrap marker only.
method.formula_comparison: All inline/display TeX spans were compared byte-for-byte against raw text, allowing only the explicitly registered domain substitution in prose[0]. No numerical calculation or proof recomputation.
method.non_math_text: Full ordered text comparison after only authorized whitespace/linebreak, bold-marker and outside-math full-stop/parenthesis normalization. E70 labels were separately compared by the exact approved Cyrillic-to-Latin mapping.
method.layout: Explicit source-equivalent exercise and proof enumeration lines checked; official prose_flow output read and matched to stored section_breaks. No HTML/PDF/image rendering.

checks.details: Both source snapshots and SHA-256 values match their current raw files. All 12 prose entries remain in order: 11 text entries plus one table marker. No omission, addition or reorder; exactly one E70 exercise with two subparts.

All source_text fields match raw text and their authoritative page-block concatenations exactly. After the approved domain substitution, modern text differs only in linebreaks/whitespace, outside-math punctuation, merged bold runs, and Latin E70 labels.
Reference lists are exact, ordered, nonempty and consistent with current raw assembly. All references resolve to their expected p/fig/ex kind and printed-page identity.

The sole candidate erratum matches the sole current p0035 registration by id, block, exact original and reason; page/printed page/page JSON SHA/PDF metadata and target also match. Candidate prose[0] contains the corrected range and declares math-correction. Faithful p0035#10 and source_text still contain the literal original range; p0036#1 recurrence remains unchanged.

Opening prose separates its three complete sentences and recurrence; the fraction introduction and each formula occupy separate lines. The aligned proof retains all four rows via three TeX row separators. Alternative proof classes 1) and 2) are complete, separate and naturally ordered. No source wrap marker remains.
